data/sources/rate-defaults.json; Enchanting cut-offs are 10/30 (data/rates/brackets.json). Early (below 10): no Experiments yet (the Experimentation Table and Superpairs Beginner need Enchanting X); enchanting at a table gives 3.5 x levels^1.5 XP (575 at 30 levels) and Experience Bottles 8-12 XP, so ~100-600 XP/min (estimate). Mid (10-29): Experiments at Beginner-Grand, 50-100k XP per Superpairs plus add-ons. Late (30+): Supreme and up, 200-400k per Superpairs plus add-ons. Per active minute; Experiments are limited to a few charges a day, which is not modelled (hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki Experimentation_Table, Experiments, Enchanting, Experience_Bottle, 2026-11-24; earlier: user answers 2026-11-24).
